answer_1.quote: With the increasing amount of information, the significance of automatic summarization has grown exponentially.

answer_2.quote: We use Rouge-L to evaluate model performance by measuring the similarity between the generated summary and the gold standard coherent summary.

answer_3.quote: We evaluated summaries generated using "w/o Feedback" and "w/ Feedback" approaches for Llama-13B, and Falcon-40B models using the G-Eval. Specifically, we utilized the coherence metric from G-Eval...

answer_4.quote: We asked three independent human evaluators (graduate student volunteers) to assess the summaries (50 randomly selected from the test set).
answer_4.guideline: Each evaluator was asked to choose their preferred summary from three options and rate each summary's coherence on a Likert scale ranging from 1 (incoherent) to 5 (perfectly coherent).
